system.name: FlexLLM
system.one_liner: co-serves LLM inference and PEFT finetuning requests at token granularity on shared GPUs with SLO guarantees

components.name: PEFT Model Hub
components.role: stores the backbone LLM (Base Model) and all finetuned PEFT variants

components.name: Finetuning Datasets
components.role: user-supplied data for a finetuning request

components.name: Inference Prompts
components.role: user-supplied prompts for an inference request

components.name: PEFT-as-a-Service Interface
components.role: unified programming interface through which users submit finetuning and inference requests and receive responses

components.name: Static Compilation (§5)
components.role: generates and optimizes the parallel computation graph for a finetuning request before execution

components.name: Hardware
components.role: target hardware description used to compile the computation graph

components.name: Model
components.role: PEFT model description used to compile the computation graph

components.name: Computation Graph
components.role: the parallel computation graph generated for the finetuning job

components.name: Dependent Parallelization (§5.1)
components.role: parallelization strategy generation for the computation graph

components.name: Graph Pruning (§5.2)
components.role: prunes the computation graph to optimize execution

components.name: Dynamic Scheduling (§6)
components.role: schedules finetuning and inference tokens together at runtime to meet SLOs

components.name: Token-level Finetuning (§6.1)
components.role: runs finetuning backward passes at token granularity over a sliding window of previous tokens

components.name: Hybrid Token Scheduler (§6.2)
components.role: iteratively schedules a mix of inference and finetuning tokens each round

components.name: Distributed Co-serving Runtime (§7)
components.role: executes the scheduled co-serving workload across distributed GPUs

content.key_idea: FlexLLM unifies inference and PEFT finetuning behind one PEFT-as-a-Service interface, statically compiling and pruning a finetuning job's computation graph, then dynamically scheduling inference and finetuning tokens together at token granularity for co-serving on a distributed runtime.
content.reading_order: Top-down: PEFT Model Hub and user requests (finetuning datasets, inference prompts) feed into the PEFT-as-a-Service Interface, which connects to the three main components below it — Static Compilation, Dynamic Scheduling, and Distributed Co-serving Runtime.

evidence: Figure 2 shows an overview of FlexLLM, which co-serves both PEFT and inference requests for LLMs
The programming interface for both inference and finetuning requests is unified through a PEFT-as-a-Service (PaaS) interface
FlexLLM comprises three main components. First, for finetuning requests that execute in parallel across multiple GPUs, the static compilation module (§5) generates a parallel computation graph

summary: This figure shows the system overview of FlexLLM, which co-serves LLM inference and parameter-efficient finetuning (PEFT) requests on shared GPUs. Users draw on a PEFT Model Hub (a base model plus multiple finetuned PEFT variants) and submit Finetuning Datasets or Inference Prompts through a unified PEFT-as-a-Service Interface, which exchanges the PEFT model, requests, and responses with three main components. The Static Compilation (§5) component takes hardware and model descriptions to generate a parallel Computation Graph, optimized via Dependent Parallelization (§5.1) and Graph Pruning (§5.2). The Dynamic Scheduling (§6) component performs Token-level Finetuning (§6.1), running backward passes over a sliding window of previous tokens, coordinated by a Hybrid Token Scheduler (§6.2) that iteratively interleaves inference and finetuning tokens. A Distributed Co-serving Runtime (§7) executes the scheduled workload and returns responses through the interface. The figure uses orange for compilation/inference-oriented elements, blue for scheduling/finetuning-oriented elements, and llama and chat-bubble icons to depict models and requests, with labeled bidirectional arrows showing the interface mediating all data exchange.
summary_zh: 该图展示 FlexLLM 系统总览：用户通过统一的 PEFT-as-a-Service 接口提交微调数据或推理提示，模型来自 PEFT 模型中心；接口连接静态编译模块（生成并剪枝计算图）、动态调度模块（按 token 粒度交织微调反向传播与混合调度）以及分布式协同服务运行时，三者共同实现推理与微调的 token 级共同服务。
